intro: Now ask your own question. Use the analysis tool to compute means and trends over any period, compare periods, and record what you find. Unexpected results are welcome — explaining them is research.
suggested_questions: Is the warming trend since 2000 faster or slower than 1975–1999?
How sensitive is the trend to the start year you choose (e.g. 1970, 1980, 1990)?
Which decade had the largest jump in mean anomaly compared with the previous decade?
Was there any 15-year period after 1975 with a negative trend?
